content: Which has the larger volume in ZETA, the incus or the malleus?
Measurements of ZETA, 2 structure(s), run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

In ZETA, the incus has the larger volume. This comes from run 19ac527c, pipeline v0.1.0, whose QC status is pass_with_warnings.

| Structure | Volume (mm³) |
|---|---|
| Incus | 16.86 |
| Malleus | 15.86 |

The incus is about 1.0 mm³ larger, roughly 6%.

- **Fragmented incus mask:** The incus segmentation has 2 connected components, with the largest holding 99.97% of the volume. The extra fragment is tiny, so it doesn't change the result.
- **Single specimen:** ZETA is the only specimen in CochleaHub, so this says nothing about how the two bones compare in general.
